Example:
Let's have two matrices of 3x3 dimension and substract them. By subracting them we mean that the elements of two matrices are substracted. The difference is also a matrix S of the same dimensions:

 [1 2 3] [9 8 7]
 S = [4 5 6] - [6 5 4] = 
 [7 8 9] [3 2 1]

 [-8 -6 -4]
 = [-2 0 2]
 [4 6 8]
